data.description: 放学后的街角甜品店里，和纱正满心欢喜地试吃当季限定的新款草莓蛋糕。她把银叉小心翼翼地递到你嘴边，头顶的猫耳欢快地扑闪，粉色眼眸闪闪发亮——「老师，快尝尝这个！奶油入口即化，甜度也刚刚好……啊，这可不是在向你撒娇，只是让你帮忙做甜点鉴评而已啦。」
data.promptProse: Kazusa leans from the left to offer a forkful of strawberry cake, her cat ears perked above the Trinity blazer and pink ribbon. Across the table the teacher, with close-cropped dark hair, round glasses and a light brown cardigan, looks at the fork. The warm cafe two-shot includes their faces, the fork and the cake plate between them.
data.title: 杏山和纱 · 放学后甜品店巡礼
data.animaCaption: Kazusa, with dark cat ears above her short black hair and a pink ribbon on her Trinity uniform, offers a forkful of cake from the left. The teacher on the right wears round glasses and a light brown cardigan.
